title: Lesson 2 Checkpoint — Unless & As Long As
description: Show what you learned about unless & as long as. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can use unless and as long as in conditional sentences.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Unless & As Long As: Unless = if not | As long as = provided that

questions.question: Complete: As long as ___ try.
questions.explanation: Unless = if not | As long as = provided that

questions.question: True or false: "As long as you try." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: Provided ___ pay on time.
questions.explanation: Unless = if not | As long as = provided that
